title: Triggering notFound in generateMetadata results in Unhandled Runtime Error Error: NEXT_NOT_FOUND

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Parallel & Intercepting Routes
labels.description: Related to Parallel and/or Intercepting routes.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/falling-water-nky943

### To Reproduce

1. Create this folder structure:
![image](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/39343843/0826fb6f-d0da-4979-b297-0d44ac121e06)
2. The selected page.tsx should be the same as default.tsx (component that return null)
3. try to visit a route that would trigger notFound() in `generateMetadata` for example `/en/test`
4. Adding `_` to `@articleModal` fixes the issue as the parallel route doesn't exit any more.
![image](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/39343843/350721b6-f54f-4125-b7b2-2e823ca261cc)


### Current vs. Expected behavior

I expected to see a not found page but got an unhandled runtime error with the thrown "NEXT_NOT_FOUND_ error.

![image](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/39343843/5636cf5e-d03d-45b3-b4e9-445163096eb5)
